name: Spellcasting (Druid)
summary: Full Wisdom caster; prepare from the druid list; ritual casting.
description: As a druid, you are a full spellcaster using Wisdom. You prepare spells from the full druid list, can cast rituals, and follow the class spell slot progression. Nonmetal armor/shields are a traditional restriction.
notes: See class spellcasting notes for circle-specific details.
